name: Democratic Party
description: Follow Democratic Party, a tracked organization, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: As Midterms Loom, Democrats Feud Over Defections
changes.summary: The fight has highlighted party divisions and raised questions about how Democrats will run the House should they win the majority.

changes.title: Veteran political journalist on division among Democrats over democratic socialism
changes.summary: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with CNN senior political analyst Ron Brownstein about the Democratic Party's division over embracing democratic socialism.

changes.title: Stephen A. Smith on Trump, Democrats and the politics of chaos
changes.summary: Stephen A. Smith on Trump, Democrats and the politics of chaos lead image.

changes.title: Voters are "pissed about the economy," former Obama aide analyzes midterms
changes.summary: Most midterm primaries have already passed, yielding data and trends that inform how general elections could go. Former Obama aide Ravi Gupta joins CBS News with more on how Democrats and Republicans are performing in the 2026 midterms so far.

changes.title: Dems demand DHS fund election security. And, journalist Gloria Steinem has died
changes.summary: Two Democrats are demanding that Homeland Security officials fund election security ahead of the midterms. And, trail-blazing journalist Gloria Steinem has died. (Image credit: Mario Tama).

changes.title: Stephen A. Smith has some words for Democrats as he makes his 2028 plans clear
changes.summary: Sports broadcaster Stephen A. Smith has been bouncing around cable TV but insists he’s staying out of one arena: the political one. The outspoken ESPN personality isn’t staying away from talking politics — far from it. But Smith told POLITICO in an interview airing Thursday that he’s not running for president in 2028 i.

changes.title: Democratic strategist on the new anti-partisan swing voters
changes.summary: Democrats in Massachusetts bucked a national trend and voted to back an incumbent in Congress. Sen. Ed Markey beat a primary challenge from Rep. Seth Moulton in a race that frequently focused on age and the party's direction. The results skew from a national narrative that Democratic voters are eager for younger leader.

changes.title: Billionaires Sent Montana Prices Soaring. Can Democrats Capitalize?
changes.summary: For years, Democrats have failed to harness the anger of Montanans contending with out-of-state wealth driving up costs. This year, a smokejumper thinks he can succeed.

changes.title: House Democrats block constitutional amendment to lock Supreme Court at 9 justices
changes.summary: The Republican-led resolution, which requires two-thirds support in the House and the Senate, is a response to increasing openness among Democrats to expand the court.

changes.title: House votes to condemn socialism, with 8 Democrats joining Republicans
changes.summary: GOP leaders scheduled the vote after Democratic primary voters embraced a number of democratic socialist candidates.
